layers: PlutoLib for opting-in mods, otherwise direct Mixins use

contracts.shared: Generic raw resource/tag traversal and the existing creative registration interface are available.
contracts.retain: Canonical namespace/removal rules, modifier eligibility and the ownership fix for scute test compatibility remain TConstruct-specific.
contracts.remaining: Current shared tag traversal does not establish that the complete original modifier change or test harness has been migrated.

contracts.shared: Equipment snapshots, resource/tag queries and native item representation are reusable read facts.
contracts.retain: Necrotic Bone rolls, Fortune/Looting levels, crop/gold eligibility and launch-to-death feature policy.
contracts.remaining: Mutable death-loot context and projectile identity/lifetime are not granted by those read facts. Historical #799/#806 mutable-killer finding is a source finding, not a new compile result.

contracts.shared: Existing quantity planners and item snapshots can support explicit operations without owning the Game tail.
contracts.retain: Momentum, Multishot, Expanded formulas, charge/ammo rules, area eligibility and retained-tool break policy.
contracts.remaining: Shot entry is not the later wear invocation. Native RNG/hooks/advancement, selected physical hand and actor scope need their own contract; native wear is not equivalent to the custom durability-loss bypass.

contracts.shared: Existing stack-fluid value operations and storage representation helpers are available.
contracts.retain: Overgrowth/Overburn eligibility, fuel rules and Overslime refill amounts.
contracts.remaining: Original TAIL declarations are retained historical blockers. Generic quantity helpers do not supply an authoritative tick completion or live actor lifetime.

contracts.shared: The v15 foundation supplies generic equipment/read-only damage facts, not a general accepted-hit or projectile-mutation authority.
contracts.retain: Padded, Insatiable, Spectral, Smite, Antiaquatic, Pierce, Bane, Enderference, Antitoxin, Flamestance, Lacerating, Scorching, Conducting and offhand formulas/selection.
contracts.remaining: Old attack_mob interior rewrite restrictions and phase/order/accepted-hit state must be resolved per real caller. Exact ChunkMap::clear target intersections require full composition review; matching strings alone neither approve nor prohibit composition.

contracts.shared: No existing value/transaction helper certifies dropped-item expiry, explosion or lightning lifecycle authority.
contracts.retain: Worldbound acquisition and protection eligibility, source item metadata and environmental policy.
contracts.remaining: Historical TAIL blockers and native lifetime/timing need a supported actual owner boundary; do not simply enqueue effects or delete old hooks.

contracts.shared: Read-only current values do not confer a timed-use or authoritative guest teleport capability.
contracts.retain: Warping acquisition, charge/duration, held-item eligibility and destination selection.
contracts.remaining: Preserve local/guest call order and actual world/actor owner around teleport. Native clear-hook composition is separate from successful teleport execution.

contracts.shared: Pure curative policy values and equipment read facts exist. Unapplied instance/NBT/contact proposals are research only.
contracts.retain: Strong Bones milk Resistance, helmet eligibility and curing policy.
contracts.remaining: Actual per-instance hidden chain/save and synchronous native actor authority are not implemented by a shared value policy or by unexecuted Game borrow probes.
